dct_title_s: British Indian Ocean Territory - Tropical storm on Oct 18 2025
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[1001228\_31](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_ts_events/items?event_id=1001228) Tropical storm during the period Oct 18 2025-Oct 25 2025 in British Indian Ocean Territory. The center of the storm was located near latitude -8.19 longitude 50.19. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
